capabilities: Navigate to previous or next heading or empty line
Copy the next or a searched-for code block
Insert a configurable default code block or callout
Search notes by tag through a modal switcher
extras: No keybindings are set on install; users must configure them themselves. Switcher extensions require setting a Default modal command in the plugin settings.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in keyboard shortcuts for moving between headings or empty lines, copying a nearby code block, or quickly inserting a code block or callout with the cursor in place.

relations.evidence: i used the Another Quick Switcher plugin which supports tags

summary: Keyboard command set for jumping between headings and empty lines, selecting heading blocks, copying and inserting code blocks and callouts, and tag search via a switcher.
